office_does: The auditor runs Whitman County's elections and voter registration, records deeds and other documents, issues vehicle, vessel and marriage licenses, and keeps the county's accounts with the treasurer.
race_blurb: Open seat: Auditor Sandy Jamison is retiring. Senior Deputy Auditor Crystn Guenthner, whom Jamison endorses, took 6,041 primary votes to 1,794 for Kenneth Millar, a county IT employee who said on primary night he hopes the winner will 'shake things up'; both filed with no party preference.

candidates.summary: Whitman County's Senior Deputy Auditor since 2019 and a Colfax city councilmember since 2018, running on experience and continuity in the auditor's office.
highlights: Senior Deputy Auditor since 2019, working in elections, recording and licensing [S1][S3]
Colfax City Council since 2018; won re-election in 2023 [S1][S7]
Would keep ballot quality-control procedures, look into postal problems and report them to the public [S3]
Endorsed by retiring Auditor Sandy Jamison [S1]

experience.basis: Senior deputy in the office since 2019, elected councilmember since 2018 and endorsed by the outgoing auditor; repeatedly campaigns on 'Trusted Experience' and preserving institutional knowledge.

candidates.summary: Colfax resident who works in Whitman County Information Technology, a former Census recruiting manager and poll worker, running on accuracy, consistency and stewardship of taxpayer resources.
highlights: Works in county IT; holds degrees in conservation ecology and biology and in accounting [S1][S3]
Would add verification checkpoints and process reviews to ballot mailing [S3]
Says public service is 'a duty, not a career' [S1]
Said on primary night he hopes the winner can 'shake things up' and make changes [S5]

experience.basis: Outsider to the auditor's office with no elected experience who calls for changes in the office, though a county employee with poll-worker and Census operations experience.
